expected_behavior: For 1000 identical BF16 factors 129/128, a 60-digit Decimal product supplies the real reference (~2397.40083017649), which rounds to BF16 2400. A float64 prod control matches at rtol=1e-12.
bug_signature: Dense BF16 CPU prod returns the upstream-reported 1632 on this AVX512 build. This exact wrong value is an environment-scoped signature, not a claim for every SIMD width, CSR path or float16 input; these variants remain outside validation.
